name: MAWIFlow Benchmark
description: A realistic flow-based evaluation dataset designed to measure intrusion detection systems' performance on network flow data.
evaluation_method: Precision / Recall / F1 (commonly reported), sometimes AUC
reputation: Built on the well-known MAWI traffic traces and used in network/IDS research for realistic flow-based evaluation, but adoption is mainly within the networking/security community.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; realistic traffic leads to class imbalance, concept drift and dataset-dependent difficulty; anonymization and sampling in traces can affect reproducibility; attack-type and labeling granularity vary, so cross-paper comparisons require care.
